Here are 30 companies. I wrote this from memory and did not open or check the links in this session, so a few may have moved. The GitHub links show the company's own Rust codebase. The rest are first-party blog posts or announcements.

```json
[
  {"company": "Cloudflare", "use": "Pingora, the proxy that handles a large share of its edge traffic", "source": "https://blog.cloudflare.com/how-we-built-pingora-the-proxy-that-connects-cloudflare-to-the-internet/"},
  {"company": "Discord", "use": "Read States service and other backend services, rewritten from Go", "source": "https://discord.com/blog/why-discord-is-switching-from-go-to-rust"},
  {"company": "Dropbox", "use": "File sync engine (Nucleus)", "source": "https://dropbox.tech/infrastructure/rewriting-the-heart-of-our-sync-engine"},
  {"company": "Amazon Web Services", "use": "Firecracker microVMs, Bottlerocket OS, parts of S3, EC2 and Lambda", "source": "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/why-aws-loves-rust-and-how-wed-like-to-help/"},
  {"company": "Microsoft", "use": "Safe systems programming in Windows and Azure components", "source": "https://msrc.microsoft.com/blog/2019/07/why-rust-for-safe-systems-programming/"},
  {"company": "Google", "use": "Android platform components (Bluetooth, Keystore2 and others)", "source": "https://security.googleblog.com/2021/04/rust-in-android-platform.html"},
  {"company": "Meta", "use": "Server-side services, source control backend, developer tooling", "source": "https://engineering.fb.com/2022/07/27/developer-tools/programming-languages-endorsed-for-server-side-use-at-meta/"},
  {"company": "Mozilla", "use": "Stylo CSS engine and other components in Firefox", "source": "https://hacks.mozilla.org/2017/08/inside-a-super-fast-css-engine-quantum-css-aka-stylo/"},
  {"company": "Figma", "use": "Multiplayer syncing server", "source": "https://www.figma.com/blog/rust-in-production-at-figma/"},
  {"company": "npm, Inc.", "use": "Authorization service on the registry", "source": "https://www.rust-lang.org/static/pdfs/Rust-npm-Whitepaper.pdf"},
  {"company": "Fastly", "use": "Lucet and Compute@Edge WebAssembly runtime", "source": "https://www.fastly.com/blog/announcing-lucet-fastly-native-webassembly-compiler-runtime"},
  {"company": "Buoyant (Linkerd)", "use": "linkerd2-proxy service mesh data plane", "source": "https://linkerd.io/2020/07/23/under-the-hood-of-linkerds-state-of-the-art-rust-proxy-linkerd2-proxy/"},
  {"company": "Shopify", "use": "YJIT, the Ruby JIT compiler, used in production", "source": "https://shopify.engineering/ruby-yjit-is-production-ready"},
  {"company": "Deno Land", "use": "The Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime", "source": "https://github.com/denoland/deno"},
  {"company": "Vercel", "use": "Turbopack bundler", "source": "https://vercel.com/blog/turbopack"},
  {"company": "Astral", "use": "uv and Ruff Python tooling", "source": "https://astral.sh/blog/uv"},
  {"company": "Materialize", "use": "Streaming SQL database", "source": "https://github.com/MaterializeInc/materialize"},
  {"company": "Oxide Computer", "use": "Hubris embedded OS and rack-scale server software", "source": "https://github.com/oxidecomputer/hubris"},
  {"company": "Meilisearch", "use": "Search engine", "source": "https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch"},
  {"company": "Embark Studios", "use": "Game development tooling and engine components", "source": "https://github.com/EmbarkStudios"},
  {"company": "Signal", "use": "libsignal, the core cryptographic protocol library", "source": "https://github.com/signalapp/libsignal"},
  {"company": "Brave", "use": "adblock-rust, the browser ad-blocking engine", "source": "https://github.com/brave/adblock-rust"},
  {"company": "Datadog", "use": "Vector observability data pipeline", "source": "https://vector.dev"},
  {"company": "Parity Technologies", "use": "Polkadot and Substrate blockchain framework", "source": "https://github.com/paritytech/polkadot-sdk"},
  {"company": "Solana Labs / Anza", "use": "Solana validator and blockchain runtime", "source": "https://github.com/anza-xyz/agave"},
  {"company": "InfluxData", "use": "InfluxDB 3 (IOx) time-series database engine", "source": "https://www.influxdata.com/blog/announcing-influxdb-iox/"},
  {"company": "Zed Industries", "use": "Zed code editor", "source": "https://github.com/zed-industries/zed"},
  {"company": "Mullvad VPN", "use": "VPN app daemon and core components", "source": "https://github.com/mullvad/mullvadvpn-app"},
  {"company": "Sentry", "use": "Symbolicator and native crash processing", "source": "https://github.com/getsentry/symbolicator"},
  {"company": "Tauri / CrabNebula", "use": "Tauri desktop app framework and related services", "source": "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"}
]
```

I can open each link and confirm it resolves and supports the claim, if you'd like.
